name: Tinker Efficiency reduces resolved power costs (#2850)
contract: Efficiency (705806) is a passive MOD_POWER_COST_SCHOOL_PCT aura of -10 over MiscValue 127, i.e. all seven schools, and needs no module binding: the stock handler writes -0.10 into UNIT_FIELD_POWER_COST_MULTIPLIER per school and SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost multiplies the resolved cost by (1 + multiplier). Its Stances field names form 28 but SPELL_ATTR2_ALLOW_WHILE_NOT_SHAPESHIFTED is set, so learning it out of form must still apply it. Measured on two percentage-cost Tinker abilities of different schools, Build: Shield Beacon (801799, physical) and Emergency Heal (802684, shadow), the cost after learning must be about 90 percent of the cost before; the band allows the integer truncation of the float product.

steps.label: Efficiency applies itself out of form
Shield Beacon costs about 90 percent of its unbuffed cost
Emergency Heal costs about 90 percent of its unbuffed cost
